checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Exactly three separate square logo images

must.why: All three spelled correctly with ampersand; logo 3 breaks to two lines but is readable.

must.item: Small symbol alongside or above the name
must.why: Wheel/moss, bike, mountain/chainring present; in 1 and 3 the name sits inside the symbol rather than beside it.
Round badge, bike with wordmark, shield crest are clearly distinct.

must.item: Green and black on plain white, no mockups or labels
must.why: Plain off-white backgrounds, green and black only, no labels or mockups.

faults.what: Logo 1 is busy: the text slab cuts across the wheel, with a grungy, messy tire edge and a tilted word that is slightly off-center.
Logo 2 bike has a malformed frame: the rear wheel looks flat, the drivetrain is odd, and the pieces don't connect cleanly. The logo is small in the frame.
Logo 3 has a messy, jagged chainring and white edges that look like AI artefacts. The text is cramped, and the shield outline is slightly off.
Backgrounds are slightly off-white rather than pure white, and the logos are raster images, not vector.

summary: Three distinct, correctly spelled green-and-black Moss & Mile logos on white; the brief is met, with minor AI roughness in the bike and chainring details.
